title: Running Headphone Specification Database
metaTitle: Running Headphone Specs Compared: Battery, Fit, IP Rating
description: Compare normalized running-headphone specifications for fit format, weight, battery, water resistance, controls, and runner use case.
intro: A normalized, source-linked reference for comparing the four finalists in Phavai's running-headphone guide. Use it to compare like with like before opening the ranked recommendations.

records.bestUse: Road or trail running when outside-sound awareness and one-piece simplicity matter

records.format: Sealed true-wireless earbuds with ear hooks
records.awareness: Transparency mode uses microphones; ear canal is sealed
records.bestUse: Intervals, gym sessions, and runners prioritizing locked-in fit and fuller sound
Outdoor running when an open-ear design is preferred without a neckband

records.singleChargeBattery: Up to 8 hours with ANC; 14 hours with ANC off
records.caseBattery: Up to 32 hours with ANC; 56 hours with ANC off
records.awareness: HearThrough mode uses microphones; ear canal is sealed
records.bestUse: Wet or rough training when rugged sealed earbuds are preferred

method: Manufacturer product pages and technical specifications supply the normalized fields.
Single-charge runtime stays separate from case-assisted total runtime.
An ear canal that remains open is labeled separately from microphone-based transparency modes.
The database describes products. Independent expert and owner evidence determines Phavai's ranking.
limitations: These are manufacturer claims, not Phavai lab results. Battery varies with volume, calls, codecs, features, temperature, and device settings. Fit and sound are personal, and product availability can change.
